PASS WITH NOTES — performance/265, exact head 9e665af8b04ef4fc03f309cfa8fb7d02211e3386, diff base dba0c080 (#263).

No blocking performance finding. Detached HEAD matched the requested SHA. The full diff contains no production change to the ancestry observer/walk, scheduling or launch sites. spawn_sites.rs is unchanged (exact-base diff exit 0, no output).

| Changed work | Added launches/s | Trigger / interval | Scaling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Select route.anchor.or(descriptor.proc), then test ancestor membership | 0 | Existing native registration, only !same_launch; no added poll/timer | One in-memory membership scan, at most 31 ancestors under the unchanged 32-process verifier cap. Independent of previous restart count and other seats. |
| Retain anchor on carried route | 0 | Existing route assignment and descriptor persistence | One inline optional ProcIdentity per route. Fixed-size identity/JSON fields, not a list or new heap-owned collection. Existing roster serializations acquire bounded extra bytes per carried seat; no added roster pass. |

Evidence: crates/daemon/src/registration.rs:1191-1228 selects an anchor by value and reuses NativeHandoff.ancestors; no new await, syscall, process liveness query, allocation of an ancestry vector, or process observation is introduced. verify_native_host (:746-803), its 32-process cap, its five-second outer deadline and its existing observation machinery are unchanged. crates/core/src/model.rs:589-640 stores one optional identity, defaults it to None and omits absent anchors from serialized JSON; carried(anchor) keeps the same single identity. cache_proxy.rs adds only anchor: None to the existing proxied gate result. The pre-existing carried-reason String allocation is unchanged. No accumulated sibling history or per-tick/per-seat work.

Zero launches means zero incremental launches for this patch. Existing macOS ancestry validation still performs cached absolute-path /bin/ps argv reads for host-named ancestors; this patch does not add one or extend the chain. Source review is inferential proof of that delta, not a live restart result. The updated sibling regression feeds each returned seat into the next registration and keeps only HOST, SHELL and the current child alive; test code inspected, not run by this no-build reviewer.

Live-before receipt: 2026-11-19T08:18:57.096917Z–08:19:17.359234Z, monotonic span 20.262 s. Same daemon PID 17600 and running commit dba0c0803b in both ping readings. Counters 655→655, all by_op deltas zero, including ps.registration-native-process at 206. The 20-second whole-machine probe observed 115.8 launches/s; per-parent sampling is only a lower bound. Daemon snapshot: 63.7% CPU, RSS 156992 KiB. CPU is high in this pre-patch snapshot; no causal claim or controlled idle claim is made. Full per-site readings, probe and resource command output are embedded.

Performed only exact-head diff inspection, live ping twice, just spawn-rate --seconds 20 --json, and /bin/ps resources. No builds, cargo, shared-build, tests, mutations or daemon restart performed. CI green and eight mutations are supplied upstream, not independently reproduced here.

Note owed: live-proof owner to repeat post-deploy counter/machine/CPU/RSS receipts and correlate the sibling restart timestamps; the current window runs #263, not #265. No code change requested for performance.

Harness insight: external-process sequence fixtures must feed output state forward and use observed parent relationships; the updated sibling fixture now does so without growing retained state. MagicWand remains a single counter-bracketed spawn-rate receipt with daemon identity and CPU/RSS, eliminating manual receipt assembly.
